title: Sweet pepper pasta with soft eggs

grandparents_cupboard.reason: Every ingredient is a plain whole food or a traditional staple such as capers, dried pasta and hard cheese.

supermarket.reason: Red peppers, cherry tomatoes, penne, eggs, capers and vegetarian hard cheese are everyday items at any Tesco.

basic_kitchen.reason: It needs only a frying pan, a saucepan and a grater, and the techniques are simple softening and boiling.

works.reason: 400g pasta, four peppers and one soft-boiled egg each make a balanced dinner for four, and the 7-minute eggs in boiling pasta water will come out jammy.

honest_times.reason: Slicing four peppers, an onion and garlic, halving tomatoes, grating cheese and peeling eggs fits 20 minutes, and the 20 plus 5 minute pepper cooking matches the 25 cook minutes, with the pasta boiling alongside.

honest_ingredients.reason: Red peppers and penne are honest names for their ids, every listed item and seasoning is used, and nothing unlisted appears apart from water.

seasonal_feel.reason: Slow-cooked sweet peppers with cherry tomatoes and basil are the heart of the dish and suit a late August evening.

plain_voice.reason: The steps are short, clear British English that a neighbour could follow.

hearty_healthy.reason: Pasta with plenty of peppers and tomatoes, eggs and cheese is a filling, balanced family dinner.
